actionableComments.author: alice
actionableComments.body: Please mention this in the changelog.

instructions: Review each item under `## Review threads`, `## Actionable comments` and decide whether it needs a code change.
Review each body under `## Review summaries (first look)`. Eligible non-human IDs are already in `--minimize-comment-ids`. Record any warranted Shepherd Journal note before review mutations.
Apply every warranted review fix in each file referenced above.
If you changed code, commit any remaining changes and push before review mutations. Otherwise, do not commit or push.

For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal 42 '- <decision>'`. See "Shepherd Journal" in the pr-shepherd skill for citation conventions.
Run the `apply review:` command shown above. See "Review-mutation mechanics" in the pr-shepherd skill for placeholder substitution and ID-retention rules.
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. After completing these steps, rerun this command to continue.
